title: Training Q and A on Whole Life Insurance: Election Withdrawal Interest Rate When Loans Have Been Drawn
content:
**What rule applies?** On an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, the interest rate on accumulations withdrawn at a reduced paid-up election is lowered for a policy drawing loans, judged by the loan advances on the policy ledger, owner loans and automatic premium loans alike, dated within the last 24 calendar months: by **1 percentage point (0.01)** where there are two or more such advances, by **0.50 percentage point (0.005)** where there is exactly one, and not at all where there is none.

**Do automatic premium loans count?** Yes. Every loan advance entry counts, whether advanced at the owner's request or automatically to pay an overdue premium.

**What is the window?** The 24 calendar months ending today. An advance dated later than the same day of the month twenty-four months ago is inside; one dated on that day or earlier is outside.

**Does a capitalization of interest count as an advance?** No. Only loan advance entries are counted.

**Worked cases (hypothetical, today June 15, 2026, declared rate 3.75%).**

| Loan advances on the ledger | Inside the window | Rate on this account |
|---|---|---|
| Owner loan August 3, 2024; automatic premium loan February 5, 2026 | 2 | 2.75% |
| Owner loan June 15, 2024; owner loan April 1, 2026 | 1 (the first is exactly 24 months ago) | 3.25% |
| None since 2021 | 0 | 3.75% |
